issue.title: Real-Obsidian e2e: Reading-view home chips dash [off::] rows and never [t::] rows
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Proposed by bob-cli-fl.5 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2) and assessed by the bob-cli-fl land agent.

bob-ledger-tools draws Pomodoro home chips in Reading view in `274-plugin-pomodoro-home-chips-reading.js`. It works out whether a session is off the clock by rebuilding the Pomodoro row from rendered text, and it reconstructs Dataview inline fields from `data-dv-key` / `.inline-field-value`. A `stampedOnly` guard keeps bare rows undashed. Only fakes cover this today; the focused test `scripts/test-pomodoro-home-chips.cjs` passes 36/36.

Proposal: add a real-Obsidian case to the existing CDP harness `scripts/obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs`. That harness already copies and enables Dataview and opens notes in Reading view.
- Fixture: a canonical daily note `YYYY/YYYYMMDD.md` with `## Pomodoros`, one `[off:: 60m]` row and one `[t:: 30m]` row, each with one Task Link to an area task.
- Assert: `.bob-pomodoro-home-chip` carries `data-home-off-clock="true"` and shows its minutes only on the `[off::]` row. A `[t::]` row is never dashed.
- Add matching `--self-test` checks.

Estimated at about 100–200 lines.

Environment: apollo has no Obsidian and no Xvfb, so the real run exits 2 with "Obsidian executable is not executable: /snap/bin/obsidian". It needs a host with the Obsidian Electron app (`-e`/`OBSIDIAN_BIN`) and a display, for example the Mac's Obsidian.app against a scratch vault. Never point it at ~/bob.

task_type_fields.proposal: Add an off-clock Reading-view home-chip case (an [off:: 60m] row dashed with minutes, a [t:: 30m] row never dashed) to bob-plugins scripts/obsidian-block-marks-e2e.cjs plus self-test checks, and run it on a host with Obsidian.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: bob-cli-fl shipped and unit-tested the behavior (fakes pass, and the deployed bob-ledger-tools 1.91.0 contains it). A real-Obsidian run needs an Obsidian host and display that apollo lacks, so it is verification tooling outside the epic's acceptance gates.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-fl.5 asked for a real-Obsidian check of Reading-view off-clock chip detection, which only fakes cover; the harness cannot run on apollo, so the fl land agent files it as a sized task.
